package ledger

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/waiting-here/NonbiriAPI/internal/db"
	"github.com/waiting-here/NonbiriAPI/internal/dbfixture"
	"github.com/waiting-here/NonbiriAPI/internal/secret"
)

// Compiled with the released source, never with the schema being tested.
func TestWriteLegacyWalletFixture(t *testing.T) {
	if db.GenerationTwoSchemaHash() != "f94972e6544ee5020c6a16451d4213c0cdef61b51814b6216ba9291e3db9734c" {
		t.Fatal("fixture generator is not linked to the released schema")
	}
	path := os.Getenv("NONBIRI_LEGACY_FIXTURE")
	if path == "" { t.Fatal("missing fixture destination") }
	dbfixture.Materialize(t,path)
	vault,err := secret.New(bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x42},secret.MasterKeyBytes))
	if err!=nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	defer vault.Close()
	store,err := db.Open(path,vault)
	if err!=nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	defer store.Close()
	ctx:=context.Background()
	tx:=beginLedgerTestTx(t,store.DB())
	first,wallet:=seedLedgerUser(t,tx,"upgrade-positive")
	second,negative:=seedLedgerUser(t,tx,"upgrade-negative")
	external,err:=CodedAccount(ctx,tx,"external")
	if err!=nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	meta:=func(actor int64)Meta{return Meta{OperationID:mustLedgerID(t,"op_"),ActorUserID:actor,CreatedAt:ledgerTestNow}}
	for _,item:=range []struct{user,account,amount int64}{{first,wallet.ID,37000},{second,negative.ID,-7000}}{
		plan,err:=NewAdminUserAdjustment(meta(item.user),item.account,external.ID,AmountFromMilli(item.amount),0,Amount{},"fixture balance")
		if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
		if _,err:=Apply(ctx,tx,plan);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	}
	var pool int64
	if err:=tx.QueryRow(`SELECT account_id FROM shared_pools WHERE pool_type='welfare'`).Scan(&pool);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	fund,err:=NewAdminPoolAdjustment(meta(first),pool,external.ID,AmountFromMilli(50000),"fixture pool")
	if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	if _,err:=Apply(ctx,tx,fund);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	welfareMeta:=meta(first)
	welfare,err:=NewWelfareClaim(welfareMeta,pool,wallet.ID,AmountFromMilli(5000))
	if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	if _,err:=Apply(ctx,tx,welfare);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	if _,err:=tx.Exec(`INSERT INTO welfare_claims(user_id,site_day,operation_id,threshold_milli,cap_milli,pool_before_milli,award_milli,created_at)
VALUES(?,'2023-11-14',?,100000,10000,50000,5000,?)`,first,welfareMeta.OperationID,ledgerTestNow);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	checkinMeta:=meta(second)
	checkin,err:=NewCheckinAward(checkinMeta,negative.ID,external.ID,AmountFromMilli(3000))
	if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	if _,err:=Apply(ctx,tx,checkin);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	if _,err:=tx.Exec(`INSERT INTO checkins(user_id,site_day,award_milli,operation_id,created_at) VALUES(?,'2023-11-14',3000,?,?)`,second,checkinMeta.OperationID,ledgerTestNow);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	for key,value:=range map[string]string{"site_name":"Synthetic upgrade fixture","legal_privacy_override_en":"Synthetic custom privacy text.","game_fishing_rtp":"90","game_fishing_rtp_premium":"88"}{
		if _,err:=tx.Exec(`UPDATE site_config SET value=?,updated_at=? WHERE key=?`,value,ledgerTestNow,key);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	}
	if err:=ValidateRecovery(ctx,tx);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	if err:=tx.Commit();err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	if _,err:=store.DB().Exec(`PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)`);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	if err:=store.Close();err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	t.Log("released binary wrote a nonempty, balanced fixture")
}

func TestLegacyRejectsUpgradedFixture(t *testing.T) {
	path:=os.Getenv("NONBIRI_UPGRADED_FIXTURE")
	if path==""{t.Fatal("missing upgraded fixture")}
	before,err:=os.ReadFile(path)
	if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	vault,err:=secret.New(bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x42},secret.MasterKeyBytes))
	if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	defer vault.Close()
	store,err:=db.Open(path,vault)
	if store!=nil{store.Close();t.Fatal("old binary opened the new schema")}
	if err==nil{t.Fatal("old binary accepted the new schema")}
	after,err:=os.ReadFile(path)
	if err!=nil||sha256.Sum256(before)!=sha256.Sum256(after){t.Fatal("rejection changed the database",err)}
}
